profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Microsoft | Prev @ NVIDIA, Meta | CS @ Rice University
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer at Microsoft. BS in Computer Science from Rice University.

Previously interned at NVIDIA (C++, 3D map visualization for autonomous vehicles) and Meta (React/GraphQL, shipped Stars on Facebook Reels).

Co-President of Rice Apps, where I lead 6 teams of 70+ developers and designers building software for Rice and the Houston community, including projects for Texas Children's Hospital.

I write about software engineering, cloud computing, and AI at decodecraft.com.

positions.description:
- Led Rice University’s student software development club of 60+ active members; oversaw 6 product teams building web applications for the campus community.

- Supervised the Open Source Accelerator and LaunchPad mentoring programs, designing a 10-week full-stack development curriculum and coordinating 20 mentors with 60 mentees across 9 hands-on projects.

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
- Co-led a team of 6 developers to design and launch a course scheduling tool used by 500+ students, built with React, MongoDB, and GraphQL.

- Mentored 4 first-time developers, leading weekly sprints and scrum sessions to track progress and maintain agile development practices.

projects.title: Messenger Clone
projects.description: This is a Messenger Clone built with React and Firebase. It simulates most of the functions available on Messenger and allows users to create profiles, add friends, create conversations and conversation groups.

projects.title: Course Scheduler
projects.description: This is a novel and user-friendly course scheduler that is currently used by over 500 Rice University students. This allows students to create mock schedules, view degree plans, check the course evaluations efficiently
